name: auto_rig
does: A skeleton AND skin weights for a bare 3D model, made by SkinTokens (TokenRig - the successor of UniRig, MIT) on Kaggle's free GPU, with its voxel clean-up against weights bleeding between parts that touch. Works for any body (creatures, wings, tails), no Maya or AdvancedSkeleton. Writes up to 3 rigs from different seeds (--out, then <out>_2, <out>_3) so the best can be kept - LOKI's creature_anim.py then makes each animation in its own file. Needs Kaggle connected; about half an hour

model.description: the model to rig (.glb, .fbx or .obj), e.g. renders/dragon.glb

out.description: the rigged model to write (.glb or .fbx)

minutes.description: how long to wait for Kaggle
